acceptance_signals: Development Monitor contract and schema advance from 1.5 to 1.6, and each of the four existing protection-event types carries a strict deterministic guidance object with a bounded action identifier, human label, read-only navigation semantics, and task-detail target.
Protection-event status remains observed_resolution_unknown; guidance never claims that handling occurred or that a later event resolved an earlier event.

JSON exposes only schema-bounded guidance data, Markdown links to its Task Detail section, and self-contained HTML uses internal fragment links to its Task Detail section without external URLs, buttons, scripts, commands, or mutation controls.
Schema validation rejects free-form, external, absolute, or unsupported guidance targets and preserves all existing false authority flags.

Focused fixtures cover all four guidance mappings, JSON and schema output, Markdown and HTML links, escaped labels, unavailable or invalid target handling, stable serialization, and unchanged unknown-resolution semantics.

Current Monitor, automatic-governance, drift-reminder, strategic-plan, status, and dated-log documents distinguish resolution guidance from future cross-event resolution evidence and consistently identify Monitor contract 1.6.

The first execution action after task take-up captures the exact task-start baseline, and final comparison reports zero failures while preserving all excluded pre-existing task, evidence, baseline, and host-configuration paths.
Focused Monitor tests, user-documentation tests, the complete supported Python 3.11 suite, task governance, repository governance, bounded privacy scanning, schema parsing, and git diff checks pass.

decision.rationale: The accountable human reviewed structured proposal prp-3639f2b1f6514c74a7adca5303504b3a and admitted that exact task through an explicit admission control.

requirement.summary: Upgrade the development Monitor to contract 1.6 by adding deterministic read-only guidance for each supported protection-event class and internal links from HTML and Markdown Protection Events to Task Detail, while preserving actual resolution as unknown and keeping the Dashboard non-authoritative.

items: Adding required guidance fields changes the development Monitor JSON contract, so the schema version and every current version-owning documentation surface must advance together.
An internal navigation link can be mistaken for remediation authority unless the data model, labels, claim limits, and tests explicitly preserve read-only guidance and unknown resolution.
Free-form or event-derived URLs would create path and injection risk; this task permits only enum-bounded internal Task Detail targets rendered by trusted code.

The worktree contains earlier admitted closeout changes and local host state, so the task-start baseline must preserve excluded files and distinguish pre-existing included documentation state from this task's post-start delta.
The complete suite may reveal compatibility expectations outside the focused Monitor tests; failing tests must not be weakened.
Reviewed assumption: The existing Task Detail section is the smallest safe destination for reviewing the task context behind each protection event.
Reviewed assumption: All four current protection-event classes can receive deterministic guidance without semantic inference.
Reviewed assumption: A development-source Monitor contract bump is acceptable because stable 0.2.1 does not expose this future 0.3 Monitor contract.
Reviewed unknown: Whether users find Task Detail sufficient to choose the next human action remains unproven until a later usability review.
Reviewed unknown: True cross-event resolution evidence remains unimplemented and outside this task.
Reviewed unknown: Benefit and Learning views and the independent automatic journey rehearsal remain separate future product decisions.

title: Protection-event resolution guidance links v1
